trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to InPrivy - Secure and easy sharing Plan
trials.reasoning: A buyer directly calls the purchase an InPrivy lifetime deal, and the prosecution reviews report bugs or access trouble with a secret but do not show lifetime access was denied or revoked.

exhibits.quote: once it I don't see a button or anything allowing me to access the first test secret I created.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports being unable to access a created secret, undermining the value of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: I tried to point out to the author the bugs in the program that prevent it from working (email and so on), but he doesn't respond anywhere.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports bugs that prevent the program from working with no author response, undermining lifetime access usability.

exhibits.quote: From my point of view, this InPrivy lifetime deal is a no-brainer. I would highly recommend it to everyone.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the purchase is an InPrivy lifetime deal.

trials.claimQuote:
- Unlimited Secrets and Folders
- Attachments (30 GB Storage)
- Custom Branding
- Custom Domain
- Custom Translations
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only show folders exist and that folder selection was missing in one creation flow; neither tests or confirms that secrets and folders are unlimited.

exhibits.quote: When I created the secret I also did not see a drop-down allowing me to choose which file folder I want to put it in.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports no folder selection when creating a secret, undermining the unlimited folders claim.

exhibits.quote: I love the expiration part and folders for different clients.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms folders functionality works for organizing clients.

trials.claimQuote:
- Team Management (Unlimited Members)
- Notifications
- Password Protection
- TOTP Two-Factor Authentication
- Strong Encryption
trials.reasoning: The defense exhibits discuss notifications and AES-256 encryption, not team management or how many members are allowed, so unlimited members is not shown.

exhibits.quote: One of my favorite features is the notification I receive when the recipient opens the shared item it helps me stay on track.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms notifications work when a recipient opens a shared item.

exhibits.quote: The data is AES-256 encrypted, with the company stating it has no access to the encrypted content itself.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms strong AES-256 encryption is used for data.

trials.claimQuote:
- Attachments (30 GB Storage)
- Custom Branding
- Custom Domain
- Custom Translations
- History Log (90 days)
- Public Sharing URL
trials.reasoning: One buyer found no attach option on a shared link while another confirms uploading documents works, but neither exhibit verifies the specific 30 GB storage amount.

exhibits.quote: I created two secrets, shared a link, opened it, and it did not show any option to attach files.
exhibits.argument: Buyer testing found no option to attach files via shared link, undermining the attachments claim.

exhibits.quote: I also love that you can upload and share documents.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms uploading and sharing documents works.

trials.claimQuote:
- History Log (90 days)
- Public Sharing URL
- Extended Link Details
- QR Codes
- Team Management (Unlimited Members)
- Notifications
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm an audit trail showing if and when items were viewed, but no exhibit verifies that the history log is kept for 90 days.

exhibits.quote: The biggest improvement for our use would be deeper automation and audit integration:
exhibits.argument: Buyer says deeper audit integration is still needed, undermining the sufficiency of the 90-day history log.

exhibits.quote: and provides a decent audit trail so you can see whether secrets have been viewed etc.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms an audit trail shows whether secrets were viewed.

exhibits.quote: and I can see exactly when something was opened.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms visibility into when shared items were opened.

trials.claimQuote: All future InPrivy - Secure and easy sharing Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit warns about lack of support, which is not the same as future plan updates, and no exhibit confirms or denies that future updates are included.

exhibits.quote: I advise buyers to prepare for the fact that there will be no support.
exhibits.argument: Buyer warns to expect no support, undermining confidence that future plan updates will be provided.

themes.summary: Many buyers say InPrivy is simple, fast, and does secure sharing exactly as promised.

hits.quote: Does exactly what it says. No Fuss. Just works.
I had my new InPrivy purchased, setup and sending in under 15 minutes.
Very intuitive to use and reliable features.
No glitches, works as expected and overall an awesome deal.
I am really happy with InPrivy. It makes sharing passwords quick and safe.

themes.summary: Several buyers call the lifetime deal a no-brainer and great value for money.

themes.summary: Several buyers praise sharing but request reverse file collection, API automation, and editing options.

hits.quote: there is no way to do this in reverse.
an API/webhook path to create and expire shares, retrieve current state
Right now, you have to select a far-future date (e.g., 100 years) for long-lived secrets.
